subject.note: These documents describe the dependency manifests of the release source tree. They do NOT describe a container image and assert no image digest; see sbom/README.md.

includes: Python distributions pinned in the image's requirements.txt, with versions
npm packages resolved in frontend/package-lock.json, with versions (ECM only)
Base and build images referenced by digest in the Dockerfile
excludes: Operating-system packages inside the base images (apt/apk); the Dockerfiles also run `apt-get upgrade` / `apk upgrade` at build time, so the installed OS package set is not derivable from the source tree at all
Transitive native libraries vendored inside Python wheels
Any image digest: no release image exists when this document is cut
